business_summary: Ozu Corporation imports, processes, sells, and exports nonwoven fabrics and disinfectants in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers electronics and clean room products, including nonwoven, disinfecting wipers, thick paper, and sterile wet wipers, as well as clean room masks, mops, sterilant, and other products. It also provides disposable sheets, cleaning towels, examination gowns, masks, storage products, and point sheets. In addition, the company offers oil absorbents and glass wipes. Additionally, it is involved in the real estate rental business. It serves electronics, cosmetics, medical, industrial materials, and decontamination industries. The company was founded in 1653 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
